transport: Loopback HTTP server, real OkHttp and filesystem; no Android network/device execution

cases.name: cached APK or complete partial cannot bypass a contradictory manifest size()
chunked exact response uses the manifest total and still verifies its digest()
chunked overflow is rejected before excess bytes reach disk or progress()
complete valid range segments continue until the pinned APK is verified()
declared larger response is rejected before writing any APK bytes()
declared shorter response is refused without persisting a partial()
nonpositive declared sizes are rejected without a request()
oversized staged partial is discarded before requesting a range()
range total must agree with the pinned manifest before appending()
truncation preserves the bounded prefix and a new instance resumes it()
